_note: Nine courts in three tiers. Presentation only: every court plays identically. Palettes avoid the fighters' identity hues (saffron/teal, indigo/silver, magenta/cyan, emerald/bronze); fighters carry their own rim light. Signage is fictional.

courts.name: Monsoon Bazaar
courts.blurb: An old-city market lane on a monsoon night: bulb strings and tarps, steaming chai kettles, scooters, a crowd under umbrellas, neon on wet stone, a hoop bolted to a heritage arch.
courts.finisherMoment: The downpour turns to a sheet, lightning backlights the dunker, umbrellas fly up.

courts.name: The Tracks
courts.blurb: A fenced concrete court under an elevated train at summer dusk: heat haze, an open hydrant, a DJ on a folding table, fans pressed against the chain-link.
courts.finisherMoment: A train passes on cue, sparks shower from the rails, fans climb the fence.

courts.name: Concrete Coast
courts.blurb: A boardwalk court at bright midday, the one daylight street: open sea, gulls, skaters in a bowl, food trucks, palm shadows, sun glare on the backboard.
courts.finisherMoment: A wave bursts over the seawall in slow motion and gulls scatter.

courts.name: Rivalry Night
courts.blurb: A packed high-school gym: a face-painted student section, cardboard heads, a drumline and brass band, a cheer squad, hand-painted banners, warm gym light.
courts.finisherMoment: Students surge to the sideline and the band hits the fight song.

courts.name: Lights Out
courts.blurb: An empty school gym after hours in a thunderstorm: half the lights off, rain streaking the high windows, a janitor's cart, stacked chairs, echoing squeaks.
courts.finisherMoment: Lightning blacks out the gym, red emergency lights glow, then the light banks clank back on one by one.

courts.name: Campus Quad
courts.blurb: University outdoor courts at golden hour in autumn: drifting maple leaves, students on the grass, bikes, a clock tower, a marching band rehearsing in the distance.
courts.finisherMoment: A gust sends a storm of leaves across the court and students rush the fence.

courts.name: The Old Barn
courts.blurb: A historic fieldhouse: wooden bleachers, iron trusses, retired jerseys, a flip-digit scoreboard, an organist, warm tungsten light through dust.
courts.finisherMoment: The backboard shatters in slow motion and the organ plays a sting.

courts.name: Glass Court
courts.blurb: An exhibition arena with an LED glass floor: court lines draw themselves at round start, footsteps ripple, the floor glows in the leader's color under chrome-white light and drone cameras.
courts.finisherMoment: The whole floor becomes the Finisher's motif: sunburst, rain ripples, glitch blocks or fissures.

courts.name: The Crown
courts.blurb: A sold-out finals arena: championship banners, steel-blue light cut by spotlights and haze, glossy reflective hardwood, courtside photographers; the jumbotron replays your last highlight.
courts.finisherMoment: Lights drop to one spotlight, then pyro columns erupt; confetti on match point.
